records.title: Journalist Welfare Scheme
details:
Hon''ble Minister inter-alia stated as under:-
All 123 proposals of the journalists have been accepted. We have released an amount of Rs. 6.15 crores to the concerned families. The State-wise report is also there with me. I can share this with the hon. Member.

records.title: Journalist welfare scheme
details: Sir, what the hon. Member has said is right. On September, 2020 the Govt. constituted a committee to review the existing guidelines of the Journalists' Welfare Scheme. The Committee also submitted the report to the Govt. We are exploring it.

records.title: Issues with respect to Agristack
details: (a) Yes, Sir. The Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare has constituted a Task Force to develop IndEA (India Enterprise Architecture) Digital Ecosystem of Agriculture (IDEA). The Unified Farmers Service Platform (UFSP) will be prepared based on the IDEA. The details and components are being deliberated by the Task Force and shall be communicated when finalised. (b) to (d): Currently only a framework document/Digital Blue Print is being prepared. Building of UFSP and involving relevant organisations shall be done once the framework is approved by Ministry.

records.title: Fraud under PM-Kisan scheme
details: Yes Sir. C&AG audit of PM-KISAN is being conducted and is still going on. There is no report given by C&AG audit on the implementation of the Scheme so far.
